title: Leo's Sticky Monster Hands: Why Washing Hands Is Fun!

lines.text: Leo spent the afternoon digging in sandbox castles and painting rainbow posters!
lines.caps: Leo spent the afternoon *DIGGING | in sandbox castles and painting *RAINBOW | *POSTERS!

lines.text: Time for lunch! shouted Mom. Leo ran straight to the table to grab a sandwich!
lines.caps: Time for *LUNCH! | shouted Mom. Leo ran straight to the *TABLE | to grab a *SANDWICH!

lines.text: Hold on! Look through the magic science magnifying glass at your fingers!
lines.caps: Hold *ON! | Look through the magic science magnifying *GLASS | at your *FINGERS!

lines.text: Millions of microscopic germ monsters were doing silly dances on his palms!
lines.caps: Millions of microscopic germ *MONSTERS | were doing silly dances on his *PALMS!

lines.text: Leo turned on the warm water tap and pumped out silky, strawberry soap!
lines.caps: Leo turned on the warm water *TAP | and pumped out silky, *STRAWBERRY | *SOAP!

lines.text: Scrub the fronts! Scrub the backs! Scrub between the fingers for twenty seconds!
lines.caps: Scrub the *FRONTS! | Scrub the backs! Scrub between the *FINGERS | for twenty *SECONDS!

lines.text: Whoosh! The soap bubbles lifted the germ monsters and flushed them away!
lines.caps: *WHOOSH! The soap bubbles *LIFTED | the germ monsters and flushed them *AWAY!

lines.text: Clean hands keep your tummy happy, healthy, and ready for delicious meals!
lines.caps: Clean hands keep your tummy *HAPPY, | healthy, and ready for *DELICIOUS | *MEALS!

lines.text: Wash up and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo for daily health facts!
lines.caps: *WASH up and | *SUBSCRIBE to | *BABYBEATS Rhymo | for daily health *FACTS!
